newsitem.title: USA: Detroit Ed Fermi nuke seen up next week.
newsitem.headline: Detroit Ed Fermi nuke seen up next week.

text.p: Detroit Edison's 1,116 megawatt Fermi 2 nuclear power plant was likely to resume electricity production the week of Nov 25 after a maintenance outage, a company spokeswoman said Monday.
"We expect it will go into a startup mode this week and resume electricity generation for customers the week of Nov 25," spokeswoman Mary Kay Bean said.
The Monroe County, Mich, unit was shut Sept 27 for scheduled refueling and maintenance.
Fermi 2 accounts for 11 percent of Detroit Edison's installed generation capacity and up to 16 percent of its daily electricity output.
Detroit Edison, a subsidiary of DTE Energy Co, is the operator and sole owner of the Fermi 2 plant.
